thread:
Kevin (oncall): paging — seeing a spike of 5xx from api-inference around 14:02 UTC, errors started at ~14:01 and peaked at 14:06. routing fallback engaged. creating bridge now.
IncidentBot: Incident created: INC-2026-321 · Severity: S2 · Bridge: https://meet.example/bridges/INC-2026-321 · Notifying oncall.
Lisa (support): getting pings from sales — customers seeing slow/failed generations. opening support ticket 12345 for Acme trial.
Anya (eng lead): thanks — Kevin what’s current status? mitigation in flight?
Kevin (oncall): mitigation in progress. failover and routing restart reduced errors, latency trending toward baseline ~14:18 but intermittent KV cache misses still spike latency.
Jamal (ops): I restarted routing-service on two pods at 14:05 per runbook. error rate dropped ~60% but not eliminated.
Nina (infra): nodes in g4dn-prod-3 show OOM kills around 14:03 — dmesg includes "Out of memory" and page cache thrash. collecting logs now.
Anya (eng lead): do we need to cordon/evict nodes? risk to throughput vs stability?
Kevin (oncall): cordoned two nodes at 14:12; traffic redistributed; error rate down to baseline after redistribution.
Lara (PM): any customer impact summary? which customers affected and how severe?
Lisa (support): three customers filed issues: truncation and delays >20s; one is a PLG trial user impacting onboarding. CS notified.
Anya (eng lead): action: open postmortem, schedule triage tomorrow 09:30 PT. attendees: eng-runtime, infra, ops, support, PM. owners: timeline + customer comms.
Kevin (oncall): created incident doc: https://confluence.example/incidents/INC-2026-321 and stubbed timeline.
IncidentBot: Postmortem meeting scheduled: 2026-06-12 16:30 UTC · Notify: #eng-runtime, #infra, #support.
Jamal (ops): immediate followups I’m jotting: 1) Tune OOM kill thresholds / kernel vm settings for g4dn pool (owner: Nina, due 2026-06-19). 2) Add KV cache hit-rate alert + runbook (owner: Kevin, due 2026-06-15). 3) Adjust pager window to reduce spikes => propose S2 only after sustained signal (owner: Anya, due 2026-06-22).
Anya (eng lead): agree with followups. proposed alert definition:
```
alert: InferenceErrorBurst
expr: increase(api_inference_5xx_total[5m]) > 0 AND
      api_inference_5xx_ratio > 0.01 for 3m AND
      histogram_quantile(0.95, api_inference_latency_seconds_bucket) > 5
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: P2
  dedupe_by: model_version
```
Add dedupe by `model_version` to avoid many identical pages.
Lisa (support): will need a support/runbook update and a customer notification template for PLG trials (owner: Lisa, due 2026-06-14).
Nina (infra): opening INFRA-789 with kernel tuning steps and a rolling deploy plan; will also add node-level OOM dashboards to Console.
Kevin (oncall): temporary suppression added for noisy non-prod routing alerts and lowered paging for PLG trial labels to prevent paging nights — will revert after fixes.
Anya (eng lead): please create GH issues and link them in the postmortem. use labels `incident-action` and `monitoring`.
Kevin (oncall): created GH issues: #1123 (add-kv-cache-alert), #1124 (pager-window-adjust), #1125 (support-customer-template) — links in the incident doc.
Lara (PM): CS/Sales want a short summary to send to impacted customers. Lisa will draft.
Lisa (support): I'll draft the one-paragraph summary and post it to the incident doc by EOD. :memo: :thumbsup:
Anya (eng lead): also adding longer-term: evaluate latency SLO per model family and consider per-model SLOs so pages aren't generated by a single outlier model. owner: Anya, due 2026-06-30.
Jamal (ops): plan to run a weekend soak on g4dn-prod-3 replica set to reproduce OOM under load and validate fixes.
Kevin (oncall): handoff: I'm off at 18:00 PT — Anya will take overnight. @Anya please ack.
Anya (eng lead): ack — taking handoff, will monitor overnight and escalate if anything else pops.
IncidentBot: Bridge closed at 15:05 UTC · Incident status: mitigated · Monitoring active.
Kevin (oncall): final ops note — change paging policy to group alerts by signature hash and only page on group increase; reduces noise while preserving S1 detection. I'll add test to verify no missed S1s.
Anya (eng lead): thanks all. we'll run a full RCA in the postmortem meeting and confirm action owners/due dates. tagging participants for postmortem review and followups.
Lisa (support): will post customer comm draft and update support runbook after that.
Nina (infra): will update dashboards and attach INFRA-789 to the postmortem doc.
Jamal (ops): will follow up on soak results and schedule a verification run after kernel tuning.
Kevin (oncall): closing notes: timeline + mitigations added to the incident doc; please add any missing logs or screenshots there. :white_check_mark:
Anya (eng lead): good work team. see you at the postmortem. :handshake:
